#:schema https://www.schemastore.org/cargo-config.json

[alias]
fmt-check   = "fmt --all --check"
lint        = "clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features"
lint-wasm   = "clippy --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --all-features"
schema      = "run --target host-tuple --features schema --bin generate-schema"
test-locked = "test --locked"
wasm        = "rustc --lib --crate-type cdylib --profile wasm-release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --locked"
wasm-json   = "wasm --message-format=json,json-render-diagnostics"

[build]
jobs = 8

[profile.wasm-release]
rustflags  = ["-Clink-args=-z stack-size=10485760"]
trim-paths = "all"

[target.'cfg(not(target_family = "wasm"))']
rustflags = ["-C", "target-cpu=native"]

# [target.wasm32-unknown-unknown]
# rustflags = ["-Clink-args=-z stack-size=10485760"]

[unstable]
profile-rustflags = true
trim-paths        = true
# sbom            = true
# script          = true
files..github/workflows/auto-release.yml:
name: Auto release

on: { push: { branches: [master], paths: [Cargo.lock] } }

permissions: { contents: read }

concurrency: { group: auto-release }

jobs:
  bump:
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    if: github.repository == 'kjanat/dprint-plugin-shuck'
    permissions: { contents: write, actions: write }
    env:
      GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: &BOT github-actions[bot]
      GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: &BOT_EMAIL 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
      GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: *BOT
      GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: *BOT_EMAIL
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with: { fetch-depth: 0 }
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@6612f0ef07ed2a736cd1e00a94a065522dd41195 # v5.2.5
      - id: plan
        run: |
          plan=$(scripts/release-bump.ts --json)
          echo "${plan}"
          echo "plan=${plan}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - if: fromJSON(steps.plan.outputs.plan).bump
        env: { version: "${{ fromJSON(steps.plan.outputs.plan).version }}", shuck: "${{ fromJSON(steps.plan.outputs.plan).shuck }}" }
        run: |
          mise run schema:gen
          git commit --all --message "Release ${version} with Shuck ${shuck}"
          git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/release/${version}"
          run_id=$(gh api --method POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/workflows/ci.yml/dispatches" \
            --field ref="release/${version}" --field return_run_details=true --jq .workflow_run_id)
          echo "ci run ${run_id}"
          gh run watch "${run_id}" --exit-status --interval 30
      - if: fromJSON(steps.plan.outputs.plan).release
        env: { version: "${{ fromJSON(steps.plan.outputs.plan).version }}" }
        run: |
          git tag --annotate "${version}" --message "Release ${version}"
          git push --atomic origin HEAD:master "refs/tags/${version}"
          gh workflow run release.yml --ref "${version}"
      - if: fromJSON(steps.plan.outputs.plan).bump
        env: { version: "${{ fromJSON(steps.plan.outputs.plan).version }}" }
        run: git push origin --delete "release/${version}"
files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI

on:
  push: { branches: [master] }
  pull_request:
  workflow_call:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: { contents: read }

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: &u ubuntu-26.04
    steps:
      - uses: &CHECKOUT actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with: &FETCH_ALL { fetch-depth: 0 }
      - uses: &MISE jdx/mise-action@6612f0ef07ed2a736cd1e00a94a065522dd41195 # v5.2.5
      - run: run -sk cargo:fmt-check cargo:test-locked cargo:lint cargo:lint-wasm wasm
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with: { name: plugin, path: "plugin.wasm\nschema.json", if-no-files-found: error }

  e2e:
    needs: [validate]
    runs-on: *u
    env: { download_dir: artifact }
    steps:
      - uses: *CHECKOUT
        with: *FETCH_ALL
      - uses: *MISE
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with: { name: plugin, path: "${{ env.download_dir }}" }
      - env: { WASM_PATH: "${{ env.download_dir }}/plugin.wasm" }
        run: run -sk scripts e2e release-notes

[package]
name         = "dprint-plugin-shuck"
version      = "0.1.3"
edition      = "2024"
rust-version = "1.99.0"
description  = "A dprint Wasm plugin for shell scripts using Shuck"
readme       = "README.md"
repository   = "https://github.com/kjanat/dprint-plugin-shuck"
license      = "MIT"
keywords     = ["dprint", "formatter", "shell", "wasm", "zsh"]
categories   = ["development-tools", "text-editors"]
publish      = false

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib", "lib"]

[[bin]]
name              = "generate-schema"
required-features = ["schema"]

[dependencies]
anyhow           = { version = "1", optional = true }
dprint-core      = { version = "0.74.0", features = ["wasm"] }
json-schema-sort = { version = "0.1", default-features = false, optional = true }
schemars         = { version = "1", optional = true }
serde            = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json       = "1"

[dependencies."shuck-formatter"]
version = "=0.2.8"

[features]
schema = ["dep:anyhow", "dep:json-schema-sort", "dep:schemars"]

[lints.clippy]
all                     = { level = "deny", priority = -1 }
cargo                   = { level = "deny", priority = -1 }
multiple_crate_versions = "allow"
nursery                 = { level = "deny", priority = -1 }
pedantic                = { level = "deny", priority = -1 }

[lints.rust]
warnings = "deny"

[profile.wasm-release]
inherits      = "release"
opt-level     = "z"
strip         = true
lto           = "fat"
panic         = "abort"
codegen-units = 1
files.README.md:
# dprint-plugin-shuck

A [dprint](https://dprint.dev) plugin for formatting shell scripts with
[Shuck](https://github.com/ewhauser/shuck). The formatter runs inside dprint's
WebAssembly sandbox; no separate Shuck executable is needed.

## Installation

Add the plugin to your dprint configuration:

```sh
dprint add kjanat/shuck
```

Format your files, or check their formatting without modifying them:

```sh
dprint fmt
dprint check
```

To update the plugin, run `dprint config update`. Each release's notes include
its bundled Shuck version and a URL for pinning that plugin version.

## Configuration

Add a `shuck` section to your existing dprint configuration, keeping the
`plugins` entry installed by `dprint add`:

```jsonc
{
  "shuck": {
    "useTabs": false,
    "indentWidth": 2,
    "dialect": "auto"
  }
}
```

All options are optional. `useTabs` and `indentWidth` inherit dprint's global
settings unless overridden in `shuck`; otherwise, Shuck's defaults apply.
See [schema.json](schema.json) for the full option descriptions and defaults.

| Option             | Purpose                                                                                       |
| ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `dialect`          | Infer from the shebang and filename with `auto`, or select `bash`, `posix`, `mksh`, or `zsh`. |
| `useTabs`          | Use tabs for indentation.                                                                     |
| `indentWidth`      | Set the number of spaces per indent, from 1 to 255.                                           |
| `binaryNextLine`   | Place binary operators at the start of continuation lines.                                    |
| `switchCaseIndent` | Indent case branch bodies.                                                                    |
| `spaceRedirects`   | Insert spaces around redirection operators.                                                   |
| `keepPadding`      | Preserve safe horizontal padding.                                                             |
| `functionNextLine` | Place function opening braces on a new line.                                                  |
| `neverSplit`       | Prefer compact layouts.                                                                       |
| `simplify`         | Apply Shuck's shell syntax simplifications.                                                   |
| `minify`           | Minify output and enable simplifications.                                                     |

Simplification and minification are opt-in. The plugin reads its settings from
dprint; it does not load Shuck project or user configuration files.

### File matching

The plugin matches `.sh`, `.bash`, `.zsh`, `.dash`, `.mksh`, and `.bats` files
by default. Use dprint's `associations` setting to include extensionless scripts
and dotfiles, or negated associations to exclude default matches. Per-file
`overrides` can select a dialect or other formatting options for specific files.

Generic `.ksh` files are not matched because Shuck does not support generic Korn
shell syntax. Select `mksh` explicitly for compatible scripts when needed.

### Limitations

The plugin formats standalone shell scripts. It does not run Shuck's linter or
format shell embedded in YAML. Range formatting leaves the file unchanged.

Shuck preserves source line endings; the plugin does not map dprint's
`newLineKind` or `lineWidth` settings. Some CRLF constructs produce upstream
parse errors, which are reported without rewriting the input.

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development, testing, and release instructions.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE).
files.mise.toml:
#:schema https://mise.jdx.dev/schema/mise.json
#:tombi toml-version = "v1.1.0"

[tools]
deno                   = "latest"
go                     = "latest"
"github:kjanat/kprint" = { version = "latest", version_prefix = "", rename_exe = "dprint", depends = ["go"] }
runner-run             = { version = "0.28.0", filter_bins = ["run", "runner"] }
binaryen               = { version = "133", version_prefix = "version_", filter_bins = ["wasm-opt"] }

[tools."go:actionlint.kjanat.dev/v2/cmd/actionlint"]
version = "936b40cf87a638978bf38dea0dd1464b898419d1"

[tool_alias]
binaryen   = "github:WebAssembly/binaryen"
deno       = "github:denoland/deno"
runner-run = "github:kjanat/runner"

[vars]
wasm_input  = "target/artifacts/plugin.wasm"
wasm_output = "plugin.wasm"

[settings]
minimum_release_age                            = "0s"
experimental                                   = true
prereleases                                    = true
idiomatic_version_file_enable_tools            = ["go"]
idiomatic_version_file_ignore_minimum_versions = true

[deps.deno]
auto = true

[tasks."build-wasm"]
description = "Build and stage the compiler's Wasm output"
run         = "deno run --frozen -RWE --allow-run=cargo scripts/build-wasm.ts {{vars.wasm_input | quote}}"
outputs     = ["{{vars.wasm_input}}"]

[tasks."wasm"]
description  = "Build the optimized {{vars.wasm_output}}"
extends      = "wasm-opt"
alias        = "b"
depends_post = ["schema:gen"]

[tasks.verify-release]
file = "scripts/verify-release.ts"

[tasks.release-notes]
file = "scripts/release-notes.ts"

[tasks.scripts]
run = "run scripts"

[tasks."schema:gen"]
alias = "cargo-schema"
run   = "cargo schema"

[tasks."schema:diff"]
depends = ["schema:gen"]
run     = "git diff --exit-code -- schema.json"

[tasks.e2e]
depends           = ["wasm"]
env.WASM_PATH     = "{{ env?.WASM_PATH or vars.wasm_output }}"
env.RUNNER_SOURCE = "deno"
run               = "run e2e"

[task_templates."wasm-opt"]
depends = ["build-wasm"]
vars    = { wasm_opt_flags = "--enable-bulk-memory-opt -O3" }
sources = ["{{vars.wasm_input}}", "mise.toml"]
outputs = ["{{vars.wasm_output}}"]
run     = "wasm-opt {{vars.wasm_opt_flags}} {{vars.wasm_input | quote}} -o {{vars.wasm_output | quote}}"
